headline: Lead Fit-out Carpenter
skills: Communicating with site engineers and clients
summary: Lead fit-out carpenter with five years building offices, shops and resort rooms in Occidental Mindoro and Palawan. I lead a crew of five, build cabinets, partitions and ceilings from shop drawings, and handle masonry repairs and finishing. My crews keep sites safe and finished work protected.

experience.title: Lead Fit-out Carpenter
bullets: Lead a crew of five on shop, office and resort fit-outs.
Build cabinets, counters, partitions and ceilings from shop drawings to within 2 mm.
Repair and refinish damaged walls, floors and door frames in older buildings.
Run toolbox talks and check scaffolds and power tools every morning.

experience.title: Carpenter
bullets: Built cottages, decks and furniture for two beach resorts.
Laid out and levelled floors and roofs with the foreman.
